summary.request: Service orders and service contracts need a Region Code. Contract invoices must take it from the contract. The code must appear on posted service invoices and on all service ledger entries, including those from credit memos, and after a service invoice is posted our field-planning system must be notified.
summary.business-process: Service management: service orders, service contract invoicing and service posting (Service-Post, Serv-Documents Mgt., ServLedgEntries-Post), plus outbound integration after posting.

objects.purpose: Holds the Region Code on service contracts so contract invoices can take it from the contract.

fields.type: Code[n], n equal to the key length of the table Region Code relates to (see open question region-code-source-table)
fields.note: TableRelation to the region table; same type and exact length as the related key. Explicit DataClassification on the field.

objects.purpose: Holds the Region Code on service orders, service invoices (including contract invoices) and service credit memos; it is the source for posted invoices and every service ledger entry.

tests.then: Service Invoice Header and the usage and sale Service Ledger Entries carry the same Region Code.

tests.given: A signed service contract with Region Code set.
tests.when: Contract invoices are created and the resulting service invoice is posted.
tests.then: The created Service Header, the Service Invoice Header and the sale Service Ledger Entries carry the contract's Region Code.

tests.given: A service credit memo with Region Code set and lines producing credit memo and credit memo usage entries.
tests.then: Every Service Ledger Entry created by the posting carries the Region Code.

tests.when: The order is posted with invoice.
tests.then: One Field Planning Notif. Outbox row exists with the posted invoice number.

An outbox row, approved privacy notice and a mocked endpoint returning success.

tests.then: The call fails with an error before any request is sent.

knowledge.used-for: Service ledger entry insert paths and contract invoice header event.
constraints: Subscribe to every ServLedgEntries-Post insert event whose entry type is needed; all service ledger entries need all four subscribers.
Parameter order differs between the events; a subscriber written for one does not match another.
Copy a contract value to the invoice header in ServContractManagement OnBeforeServHeaderModify.
Add the field to Warranty Ledger Entry and subscribe to OnBeforeWarrantyLedgerEntryInsert only when warranty analysis needs it.
Do not find service ledger entries after posting and Modify them.

knowledge.used-for: Posted service document mirroring and follow-up after service posting.
constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on Service Header and each posted table the plan needs; no subscriber for that hop.
Posted documents exist only after Finalize; do not Get the posted invoice from a subscriber that runs while lines are posted.
Do follow-up work in OnAfterPostServiceDoc using the posted document numbers it passes.
OnAfterPostServiceDoc has no PreviewMode parameter and is not raised in posting preview; do not add one.
An error there does not undo posting; hand external calls to an outbox; do not Commit when CommitIsSuppressed is true.

knowledge.used-for: Field-number mirroring rule the service article refers to.
constraints: TransferFields matches by field number; a different number is skipped without error.
Keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables.
Do not patch posted documents with an OnAfter insert subscriber and Modify.

knowledge.used-for: Outbox rule for after-posting follow-up referenced by the service article.
constraints: Treat the after-posting event as follow-up processing, not as part of posting.
Do not call Commit() in the subscriber; when CommitIsSuppressed is true the caller owns the transaction.
Insert an outbox row and let a recurring job queue entry send it; make the call idempotent.

knowledge.used-for: Type and length of the mirrored Region Code.
constraints: A field mirrored across a TransferFields cascade has the exact same number, data type and length on every table in the cascade.

knowledge.used-for: Sizing Region Code against the table it relates to.
constraints: Read the related field's declared type and length; do not assume Code[10] or Code[20].
An unconditional TableRelation field has the same type and exact length as the related field.

knowledge.used-for: Stored field versus related table on Service Ledger Entry (applies from BC23).
constraints: Put optional, sparse or integration attributes on hot ledgers in a related table keyed by Entry No.
Use a stored tableextension field only when the value must appear as a native list column and is read on almost every access.

knowledge.used-for: Decisions for the new outbox and setup tables: setup, privacy, permissions.
constraints: Plan setup, data classification and permissions for every new table instead of only the table and page.
A decision the request does not settle is a question for the requester, not a default.

knowledge.used-for: Planning order for the outbound field-planning notification.
constraints: Outbound calls never run inside a write transaction; record an outbox row and send it from a recurring job queue entry.
Use a stable idempotency key per outbox row; the external service must deduplicate.
Who calls whom, how often and what the external service does with a repeated request are questions for the requester.

knowledge.used-for: Deferring the HTTP call out of posting.
constraints: Insert the outbox work item in the same transaction as the change and process committed rows with a recurring job queue entry.
The worker performs HTTP before deleting the item; do not use Commit() as a general remedy.

knowledge.used-for: Retry safety of the notification.
constraints: Send a stable request ID that exists before processing, such as the outbox row SystemId, on every attempt.
Delete the outbox row only after the external call and all local updates succeed; a Processed flag does not solve the failure window.

knowledge.used-for: Job queue handler behaviour.
constraints: No Confirm, Page.RunModal, Report.RunModal, upload, download or Message-only outcome in the job queue entry point.

knowledge.used-for: Job queue failure reporting.
constraints: Let an error that invalidates the run propagate out of the entry point; do not swallow a failed TryFunction or Boolean result.

knowledge.used-for: Transport failure handling in the sender.
constraints: When the Boolean return is captured and false, do not read status, headers or content.

knowledge.used-for: HTTP status handling in the sender.
constraints: Check IsSuccessStatusCode or the expected status before treating the body as a success payload.

knowledge.used-for: Consent before sending data to the field-planning system.
constraints: Check the integration's own notice ID before sending; use GetPrivacyNoticeApprovalState when the flow must not show UI.
No path issues the request without approval; do not borrow a built-in notice ID.

knowledge.used-for: Registering the field-planning privacy notice.
constraints: Use a stable extension-owned ID registered through Privacy Notice OnRegisterPrivacyNotices or CreatePrivacyNotice; use the same ID for consent checks.

knowledge.used-for: Where field-planning credentials are stored.
constraints: Credentials live in IsolatedStorage, never in a table field, including a setup table.

knowledge.used-for: Carrying credentials (applies from BC23).
constraints: Declare credential parameters and variables as SecretText end to end; never round-trip through Text.

knowledge.used-for: Authentication choice for the field-planning call.
constraints: When the partner supports OAuth, use the OAuth2 codeunit; keep tokens and secrets as SecretText in IsolatedStorage.

knowledge.used-for: Endpoint URL stored in setup.
constraints: Before any HttpClient call whose URL comes from a table field, validate it with Uri.AreURIsHaveSameHost or Uri.IsValidURIPattern and error when it fails.

knowledge.used-for: Classification of added fields and new tables.
constraints: Every Normal field a tableextension adds needs an explicit DataClassification; a table-level value covers fields of the table itself.

knowledge.used-for: Release readiness of classification.
constraints: No field ships with DataClassification = ToBeClassified.

knowledge.used-for: Permission set structure.
constraints: Ship a non-assignable building block and an assignable role-shaped set that includes it.

knowledge.used-for: Permission set entries.
constraints: Enumerate each table and tabledata entry explicitly with only the letters needed; no wildcards.

knowledge.used-for: Page fields showing Region Code.
constraints: From runtime 13.0 (BC24) define the tooltip on the table field and let bound page fields inherit it; earlier targets need page-level tooltips.
Tooltip text explains what the value is used for, without invented effects.

knowledge.used-for: Field Planning Setup table and page.
constraints: Primary Key Code[10] is the sole key; card page with InsertAllowed = false, DeleteAllowed = false and an open-time insert of the blank row.

knowledge.used-for: Test fixtures.
constraints: Build prerequisite data with the test Library codeunits, parents first, and Validate foreign keys; no hand-rolled Init/Insert.

knowledge.used-for: Test structure.
constraints: Tag the codeunit with [FEATURE] and each test with [SCENARIO], [GIVEN], [WHEN], [THEN].

open-questions.question: Which table does Region Code relate to (an existing table such as a territory or country/region table, or a new Region table)? Its key type and length fix the field type on every table.
Where does Region Code come from on service orders, standalone service invoices and service credit memos: manual entry only, or a default from the customer, ship-to address or service item?
Must Region Code also appear on posted service shipments and posted service credit memos (Service Shipment Header, Service Cr.Memo Header) and on posted lines?
Does warranty analysis need Region Code on Warranty Ledger Entry as well?

Are there service ledger entries that must carry Region Code but are created outside ServLedgEntries-Post posting (for example during contract invoice creation)? The opened knowledge covers only the four ServLedgEntries-Post insert paths.
Is Region Code needed as a native column on service ledger lists and read on most accesses, or could it live in a related table keyed by Entry No.?

How is the field-planning system notified: HTTP push from Business Central (endpoint, payload, authentication, OAuth support) or does it pull through an API? Does it deduplicate on an idempotency key?
How soon after posting must the notification arrive (job queue recurrence), and does it apply to every posted service invoice, including contract invoices, or only some?
Which data does the notification send (invoice number only, or customer and address data)? This sets the privacy notice text and data classification.
Must existing service contracts and open service documents get a Region Code on upgrade, or stay blank?

unresolved: bc-version, countries and application-area were not supplied; performance/prefer-related-table-over-extension-on-hot-ledgers and security/secrettext-for-credentials apply from BC23 and style/tooltip-required-on-page-fields inheritance from BC24 (runtime 13.0).

The field-planning system's interface (protocol, endpoint, payload, authentication) is not covered by BCQuality knowledge; the sender design rests on the outbound guidance and must be confirmed against the answer to field-planning-interface.
